claims: The policy conditionally permits original fan creations shared freely, including websites and personal enjoyment. It requires unofficial attribution, existing notices, respect for third-party rights and compliance with Wizards terms, and excludes verbatim copying/reposting and specified mechanics/logos/trademarks. Donations, advertising and sponsorship may support qualifying free content subject to conditions; paid access, sales and compensated licensing need additional permission. It is not blanket authorization for this verbatim source-derived database or an unspecified future service.
notes: Hash binds the retained projection/summary, not the full upstream webpage. Supported observation does not grant admission or complete source-policy clearance.
